reasons.persona_fit: Speaks directly to a small-business owner-operator in Bareni's calm, pragmatic voice, respecting the zero-CTA rule and human-in-the-loop boundaries.
reasons.clarity: Logical and transparent structure that clearly frames why stopping rules fail and guides the reader through exception handling.
reasons.actionability: Provides a practical, concrete exercise—creating a one-page exception map categorising automated checks, human routing, and non-auto-approvals.
reasons.factual_grounding: Accurately references the accounts-payable demo, explicitly qualifying it as a self-built prototype on synthetic data rather than a customer result.
